title: Racialized Language in Criminal Courtrooms
description: An empirical study of racialized language patterns in U.S. criminal courtrooms and their relationship to case outcomes.

title: Judicial Gender Composition and Sentencing in Japanese Criminal Courts
description: A statistical analysis of roughly 620 Japanese criminal cases examining how the gender composition of judicial panels affects sentencing severity, with a focus on sexual offense cases.

title: Larry P. v. Riles Project
description: Research assistant to Prof. Alfredo Artiles and Prof. Bill Koski on the landmark special education case Larry P. v. Riles.
